sections.why: Only `{game_time}` and a few template parameters exist. Template authors want `{uses}`, `{weight}`, `{condition}`, `{condition_severity}`, `{condition_duration}`, `{condition_cause}`, `{condition_effects}`, etc.
sections.how:
- Pure templating done in `_render_template` context building - no engine logic change, just more context keys.
- The `{condition_*}` parameters only make sense once conditions are rich (task-190), so they should gate behind that work.
- Composes with aliases in labels, so template text stays readable.

acceptance.text: Trigger editor parameter inputs display contextual placeholder text and descriptive labels.
Parameter schemas define validation constraints and human-readable tooltips.

files: engine/trigger_system.py - extend context building (lines 1652-1704) with new template parameters
engine/item_actions.py - expose item `uses` and `weight` to the template context
